0:
cd /opt/traccar
./jre/bin/java -jar tracker-server.jar conf/traccar.xml &
JAVA_PID=$!
sleep 3
tail -f logs/tracker-server.log &
wait $JAVA_PID

/media/music/{{`{{ artists .Release.Artists | sort | join "; " | safepath }}`}}/({{`{{ .Release.ReleaseGroup.FirstReleaseDate.Year }}`}}) {{`{{ .Release.Title | safepath }}`}}{{`{{ if not (eq .ReleaseDisambiguation "") }}`}} ({{`{{ .ReleaseDisambiguation | safepath }}`}}){{`{{ end }}`}}/{{`{{ pad0 2 .Track.Position }}`}} {{`{{ .Track.Title | safepath }}`}}{{`{{ .Ext }}`}}

set -eu
export HOME=/tmp
aws s3 sync /data/crdSchemas/ s3://k8s-schemas \
  --delete \
  --acl public-read \
  --endpoint-url https://s3.rbx.io.cloud.ovh.net

echo "🚀 Starting Offsite Sync to Google Drive..."

cp /config-ro/rclone.conf /tmp/rclone.conf
chmod 600 /tmp/rclone.conf

rclone sync /data/backups/homeassistant gdrive:homeassistant-backups \
  --transfers 16 \
  --checkers 16 \
  --fast-list \
  --delete-after \
  --log-level INFO \
  --stats 1m \
  --retries 3
echo "✅ Offsite Sync Complete!"
